rule.name: CallValueStoredInSharedField
rule.message: This method of a shared component (a singleton Spring bean, a servlet or a filter) stores a value built from its own argument in an instance field. One instance serves every call, so the next call, possibly on another thread, reads the value of the first caller: data from one request leaks into another. Keep the value in a local variable and pass it on, or key it by caller in a concurrent map, or make the bean prototype-scoped. Configuration set once belongs in the constructor, a @PostConstruct method or a setter used at start-up. An exception fits a one-time lazy initialisation that is meant to latch the first value; do it in an init method instead.
